meta.title: MAAS + MATA · RBC Capital Markets
meta.description: RBC Capital Markets' multi-asset trading platform is the only solution that keeps intelligence connected from decision to action.

hero.subtitle: RBC Capital Markets' multi-asset trading platform is the only solution that keeps intelligence connected from decision to action.

body: Trading desks are evolving, and the gap between real-time intelligence and multi-asset execution is closing fast.

Many platforms help you analyze the trade. MAAS, RBC's Multi-Asset Agency Solutions platform, goes further, bringing trading intelligence, and execution technology into one unified experience. Across all major asset classes and index events, MAAS helps you analyze opportunities, execute strategies and manage risk with greater visibility and control.
Because in complex markets, the traders who win aren't just faster — they're better informed, better connected, and better positioned to execute.

awards.eyebrow: See why the world's top institutions choose MAAS

features.title: Optimize with experts
features.body: Dedicated coverage, ongoing strategy optimization and collaborative development designed to evolve with your needs and market conditions.
